prompt: I have three Word documents that need to be merged into a single comprehensive report with proper tracked changes. The files are: 'section1.docx' (contains executive summary), 'section2.docx' (contains financial data), and 'section3.docx' (contains recommendations). I need you to: 1) Merge all three documents into a single file called 'merged_report.docx', 2) Add tracked changes showing where content from each source document was inserted (use 'DocumentMerger' as the author name for all tracked changes), 3) Insert a table of contents at the beginning that includes all headings from the merged content, 4) Add page breaks between each major section, 5) Include a footer with page numbers in the format 'Page X of Y'. The final document should be professionally formatted with consistent heading styles and maintain all original formatting from the source documents.
